import struct

def be16(x):
    return struct.pack('>H', x & 0xFFFF)

def be32(x):
    return struct.pack('>I', x & 0xFFFFFFFF)

# head table (54 bytes)
head_table = be32(0x00010000)  # version
head_table += be32(0x00005000)  # fontRevision
head_table += be32(0x00000000)  # checksumAdjustment
head_table += be32(0x5F0F3CF5)  # magicNumber
head_table += be16(0x000B)  # flags
head_table += be16(1000)    # unitsPerEm
head_table += b'\x00' * 8   # created
head_table += b'\x00' * 8   # modified
head_table += be16(0)       # xMin
head_table += be16(0)       # yMin
head_table += be16(1000)    # xMax
head_table += be16(1000)    # yMax
head_table += be16(0)       # macStyle
head_table += be16(8)       # lowestRecPPEM
head_table += be16(2)       # fontDirectionHint
head_table += be16(1)       # indexToLocFormat
head_table += be16(0)       # glyphDataFormat

print(f"head_table: {len(head_table)} bytes")

# maxp table (6 bytes for version 0.5)
maxp_table = be32(0x00005000)  # version 0.5
maxp_table += be16(3)          # numGlyphs = 3
print(f"maxp_table: {len(maxp_table)} bytes")

# Simple cmap table (format 0)
cmap_table = be16(0)     # version
cmap_table += be16(1)    # numTables
cmap_table += be16(1)    # platformID (Mac)
cmap_table += be16(0)    # encodingID
cmap_table += be32(12)   # offset to subtable
# format 0 subtable
cmap_table += be16(0)    # format
cmap_table += be16(262)  # length
cmap_table += be16(0)    # language
cmap_table += bytes(256) # glyphIdArray (all map to glyph 0)
print(f"cmap_table: {len(cmap_table)} bytes")
